topic: event listener never removed on component unmount, firing on stale instance
question: Quick reminder — what was the actual root cause?
butterfly_answer: `.bind(this)` in `socketClient.js:5` — it created a new function reference each time, so `off()` could never match the original listener to remove it.
lastN_answer: The prior context doesn't include it — the conversation only covers style and config discussions (file extensions, arrow vs function declarations, prettier line length, timestamps, logging libraries). No root cause was mentioned.
needle_fact: In socketClient.js, the `on()` method called `fn.bind(this)` before pushing to the listeners array, so `off()`'s `l !== fn` filter could never match the stored (bound) reference — every unmount left the listener in place.
